summary_brief: AI Agent 工作流编排能力显著增强，多个框架（Agno、CrewAI）同时引入条件逻辑和 Else 分支支持，提升了复杂任务处理能力。安全性和稳定性成为今日重点，涉及 Shell 注入漏洞修复、API 凭据泄露防护、版本紧急回退等关键安全事件。MCP 生态持续扩张，Claude 官方市场新增 PostHog 分析和 CodeRabbit 代码审查插件，同时多个工具集成 MCP 提示词支持。

engineering_signals.title: AI Agent 工作流条件逻辑增强成为集体趋势
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: 多个主流 Agent 框架（Agno 2.4.7、CrewAI、Agno 2.4.6）在同一周期内推出 Else 分支和条件步骤支持，标志着 AI Agent 从简单线性执行向复杂决策树演进，这是构建生产级多智能体系统的关键能力跃升。

engineering_signals.title: AI 安全边界加固：Shell 注入与凭据泄露防护
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: 同一天内两个关键安全修复（Zed Shell 注入漏洞、Gemini CLI MCP 凭据泄露）暴露了赋予 AI 强大终端能力时的安全风险。这反映了社区在扩展 AI 能力的同时，正积极建立严格的安全隔离和权限控制机制。

engineering_signals.title: 结构化输出标准化迁移：从 JSON 字符串到 Pydantic 模型
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: CrewAI 推出的 Breaking Change 将跨多个 LLM 提供商的结构化输出从 JSON 字符串统一迁移到 Pydantic 模型，提升了类型安全和开发体验，同时也预示着行业正在建立更规范的结构化输出接口标准。

engineering_signals.title: MCP 生态快速扩张：分析、代码审查与提示词集成
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: Claude 官方市场新增 PostHog 分析插件和 CodeRabbit 代码审查插件，同时 Cline 集成 MCP 提示词支持。MCP 正从单纯的工具协议发展为连接 AI 与企业工具链（分析、测试、CI/CD）的标准生态接口。

engineering_signals.title: 异步性能优化与状态管理跨项目推进
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: 从 OpenHands 的 API key 加密异步迁移，到 Deer-flow 的 MCP 工具异步流式接口，再到 Codex 的 SQLite 持久化存储，多个项目同步推进异步架构和状态管理优化，反映出 AI 系统正在从原型验证向高性能、可持久化的生产级架构演进。

engineering_signals.title: AI 代码审查从自动触发转向按需使用模式
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: Agno 将 Claude CI 从自动触发改为按需触发（@claude mention），减少噪音的同时保持 AI 助手可用性。这反映了 AI 工具集成从'自动化优先'向'开发者体验优先'的务实转变，避免了过度自动化导致的通知疲劳。

engineering_signals.title: Token 成本治理成为生产环境刚需
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: Codex 引入自动压缩机制、LlamaIndex 添加 TokenBudgetHandler 进行成本控制，多个项目同时关注 Token 效率和成本治理。这表明 AI 应用从实验场景走向生产环境时，成本控制和资源优化已成为核心工程挑战。

engineering_signals.title: Claude Code 生态关键版本依赖稳定性问题
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: Claude Code 2.1.21 和 Agent SDK 0.2.21 版本在合并后因问题紧急回退，暴露了快速迭代中的兼容性风险。虽然随后发布的 v1.0 CI/CD Action 标志着成熟度提升，但版本稳定性仍需持续关注。

releases.summary:
# 🎉 Claude Code GitHub Action v1.0 - Now Generally Available!

We're excited to announce the v1.0 release of Claude Code GitHub Action! This major release brings significant improvements in simplicity, flexibility, and power to AI-assisted development workflows.

## 🚀 What's New in v1.0

### Simplified Configuration
- **Automatic mode detection** - No more manual `mode` configuration. The action intelligently determines whether to run in interactive or automation mode based on your setup
- **Unified interface** - All prompts now go through a single `prompt` input, and all CLI options through `claude_args`
- **Better SDK alignment** - Closer integration with the Claude Code CLI for a consistent experience

### More Powerful & Flexible
- Direct access to all Claude Code CLI capabilities through `claude_args`
- Support for custom system prompts, tool configurations, and model selection
- Enhanced compatibility with AWS Bedrock and Google Vertex AI

## ⚠️ Breaking Changes

This release includes breaking changes from v0.x. Key deprecated inputs have been replaced with a cleaner, more intuitive API:
- `mode`, `direct_prompt`, `override_prompt` → unified `prompt` input
- `custom_instructions`, `model`, `allowed_tools`, `mcp_config` → `claude_args` with CLI format
- Other deprecated: `disallowed_tools`, `anthropic_model`, `trigger_phrase`, `timeout_minutes`

**📚 Please review our [Migration Guide](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code-action/blob/main/docs/migration-guide.md) for detailed upgrade instructions and examples.**

## 💡 New Use Cases & Examples

Explore the expanded possibilities with v1.0! We've created comprehensive examples showcasing various workflows:

- **Automated PR Reviews** - Intelligent code review on every pull request
- **CI Failure Fixes** - Automatically diagnose and fix failing tests
- **Issue Triage** - Smart categorization and response to new issues
- **Documentation Generation** - Keep docs in sync with code changes
- **Security Scanning** - Proactive vulnerability detection
- **And many more!**

**🔧 Check out all examples at [github.com/anthropics/claude-code-action/tree/main/examples](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code-action/tree/main/examples)**

## 🏃 Quick Start

```yaml
# Interactive mode - responds to @claude mentions
- uses: anthropics/claude-code-action@v1
  with:
    anthropic_api_key: ${{ secrets.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY }}

# Automation mode - runs immediately with prompt
- uses: anthropics/claude-code-action@v1
  with:
    prompt: "Review this PR for security issues"
    anthropic_api_key: ${{ secrets.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY }}
    claude_args: |
      --model claude-4-0-sonnet-20250805
      --max-turns 10
```

## 📖 Resources

- [Migration Guide](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code-action/blob/main/docs/migration-guide.md) - Step-by-step upgrade instructions
- [Examples](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code-action/tree/main/examples) - Ready-to-use workflow templates
- [Documentation](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code-action#readme) - Complete setup and configuration guide

## 🙏 Thank You

Thank you to our beta users for your invaluable feedback that shaped this release. We're excited to see what you'll build with Claude Code GitHub Action v1.0!

releases.author: github-actions[bot]
releases.summary:
This week's release includes support for installing agents through the new [ACP Registry](https://zed.dev/blog/acp-registry), Agent message queuing as the default behavior (with the ability to edit and interrupt queued messages), per-tool permissions when confirming agent tool use, MCP server support for remote development, Vim-style tag stack navigation for "Go to Definition" jumps, EditorConfig inheritance from parent directories, and improved Dev Container support including Podman.

## Features

### AI

- Agent: Added the ability to install new Agents via the ACP Registry. ([#47470](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/47470))
- Agent: Added the ability to edit queued messages. ([#47234](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/47234))
- Agent: Added a menu item in the agent panel right-click menu for copying a given agent's response. ([#46529](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/46529); thanks [DepsCian](https://github.com/DepsCian))
- Agent: Added `@diagnostics` to "New Thread" conversations so you can feed current language-server diagnostics directly into the Agent Panel context. This keeps parity with text threads while staying within the cursor-aware assistant workflow. ([#42270](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/42270); thanks [GoldStrikeArch](https://github.com/GoldStrikeArch))
- Agent: Made it easier to interrupt the agent while having messages in the queue. ([#46954](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/46954))
- Agent: Made queuing prompts the default behavior when sending them while there's an on-going generation. ([#46797](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/46797))
- Agent: Added reasoning content support for the OpenAI provider. ([#43662](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/43662); thanks [aeroxy](https://github.com/aeroxy))
- Agent: Changed the display of tokens for OpenAI models to reflect the input/output limits. ([#46829](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/46829))
- Agent: Changed the behavior of queued messages to gracefully wait for the current activity to complete. ([#46980](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/46980))
- Agent: Improved streaming tool call performance by batching UI updates. ([#46802](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/46802))
- Agent: Added support for running MCP servers on the remote server when using remote development. This can be enabled by setting the `"remote": true` property in the settings entry for the MCP server. ([#46756](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/46756))
- Agent: Added the ability to set per-tool permissions when confirming/denying tool use. ([#46284](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/46284))

### Languages

- Markdown: Improved bracket colorization. ([#47026](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/47026))
- Python/Ty: Added support for using venv-installed ty binary. ([#47029](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/47029))

### Vim / Helix

- Added Vim-style tag stack navigation. "Go to Definition" jumps are now tracked in a dedicated stack, so you can navigate back through them without wading through your full navigation history. Use the new `pane: go to older tag` and `pane: go to newer tag` commands. ([#46002](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/46002); thanks [zenazn](https://github.com/zenazn))

### Remote Development

- Changed opening bundled files, keymap, local release notes and the log file view to open in remote windows instead of opening a new local Zed window. ([#46910](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/46910))
- Changed opening the settings files, keymap files, task files and debug files to open within WSL windows instead of opening a new local Zed window. ([#46910](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/46910))

### Other

- Improved Dev Container support ([#47021](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/47021); thanks [KyleBarton](https://github.com/KyleBarton)):
    - Added modal to initialize a dev container definition in the project with `projects: initialize dev container`.
    - Added Podman support for dev container actions with the `use_podman` setting.
    - Improved devcontainer error handling.
- Workspace: Added the list of recent projects to the multi-project title bar menu. ([#46828](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/46828))
- Added the language server's path to a tooltip that is shown when hovering on its status in the language server menu. ([#47037](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/47037))
- Added support for `.editorconfig` files outside the project directory. Zed now traverses parent directories to find and apply EditorConfig settings. Use `root = true` in any `.editorconfig` to stop inheriting settings from parent directories. ([#46332](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/46332))
- Settings UI: Added support for viewing and updating project settings files in remote projects. ([#45292](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/45292))
- Improved `pane::CloseActiveItem` to close center pane items even when focus is on a dock panel like the project panel or outline panel. ([#46421](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/46421); thanks [FloppyDisco](https://github.com/FloppyDisco))

## Bug Fixes

- ACP: Fixed env vars not being properly applied to built-in ACP agents. ([#46946](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/46946))
- Agent: Fixed a bug with the message queue in the agent panel where @-mentions weren't being displayed in the message preview within the queue entries list. ([#46964](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/46964))
- Agent: Fixed terminal command truncation in the agent panel to better expose long commands (e.g., potentially dangerous multi-line commands are now fully visible before execution). ([#40570](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/40570); thanks [miguelcsx](https://github.com/miguelcsx))
- Agent: Fixed Anthropic models not appearing in the Copilot Chat model picker. ([#47591](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/47591))
- Debugger: Fixed a crash that occurred when splitting a pane by dragging a pane item that originated from that pane. ([#46806](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/46806); thanks [xcb3d](https://github.com/xcb3d))
- Terminal: Fixed vi mode cursor not visually updating when navigating with vi motion keys. ([#46762](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/46762); thanks [xcb3d](https://github.com/xcb3d))
- Fixed "Add Folder to Project" and "Remove from Project" menu items being incorrectly hidden on remote projects. ([#47283](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/47283))
- Fixed `editor::AddSelectionAbove` and `editor::AddSelectionBelow` when skipping over soft-wrapped lines to preserve the original cursor column when adding selections through lines shorter than the starting position. ([#46911](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/46911))
- Fixed a bug with very wide tables not being fully visible in markdown previews. ([#46834](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/46834))
- Fixed agent model selector cutting off models at the end of the list. ([#47263](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/47263))
- Fixed an issue where a few file descriptors would be leaked each time a project was closed. ([#47246](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/47246))
- Fixed an issue where rebuilding a dev extension would compile the extension in release and not debug mode. ([#47165](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/47165))
- Fixed context menus dismissing/canceling when the window loses focus. ([#46866](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/46866); thanks [notnotjake](https://github.com/notnotjake))
- Fixed incorrect rendering of characters at large font sizes on macOS. ([#45957](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/45957); thanks [JonyLab](https://github.com/JonyLab))
- Fixed issue where markdown tables rendered within lists would overlap items above/below it. ([#46783](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/46783))
- Fixed json-language-server not considering `file_types` from project settings. ([#46991](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/46991))
- Fixed onboarding page saving the selected theme based on the system appearance and not the currently selected one. ([#47245](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/47245); thanks [HackAttack](https://github.com/HackAttack))
- Fixed poetry environment not discovered on Linux. ([#47100](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/47100); thanks [lingyaochu](https://github.com/lingyaochu))
- Fixed project search include/exclude filters not working correctly in remote project with multiple folders. ([#47280](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/47280))
- Fixed remote connections getting stuck in limbo when the server side dies unexpectedly. ([#47200](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/47200))
- Fixed screen sharing performance on Windows and Linux. ([#46986](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/46986))
- Fixed terminal cyan color displaying as green in One Light theme. ([#45691](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/45691); thanks [MateoKruk](https://github.com/MateoKruk))
- Fixed trackpad scrolling being too fast in terminal applications with mouse mode enabled (tmux, Neovim, opencode, etc.). ([#45600](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/45600); thanks [emamulandalib](https://github.com/emamulandalib))
- Fixed "Format Selection" not working when editing files over SSH remote connections. ([#47194](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/47194))
- Fixed AI commit message button in Git panel being hidden instead of disabled when no AI provider is configured. The button now remains visible with a tooltip explaining how to enable the feature. ([#46525](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/46525); thanks [ivan-magda](https://github.com/ivan-magda))
- Fixed language injections sticking after language comment removed. ([#47790](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/47790))
- Fixed mistyping the SSH password in the askpass prompt on Windows locking you out of retyping the correct one. ([#47760](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/47760))
- Fixed excessive disk space usage from the `hang_traces` directory. ([#47693](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/47693))
- Fixed a bug where terminal tasks failed to start on Windows when using `cmd.exe`. ([#47627](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/47627))

key_changes: 通过 ACP Registry 支持安装新的 Agents
Agent 消息队列成为默认行为，支持编辑和中断排队消息
为 Agent 工具使用确认添加了按工具权限控制
新增 Vim 风格标签栈导航用于"转到定义"跳转
改进 Dev Container 支持包括 Podman
ai_summary.summary_cn: Zed v0.221.4 版本主要带来了 AI Agent 功能的重大增强，包括通过 ACP Registry 安装新 Agents、消息队列默认行为、编辑排队消息以及按工具权限控制等核心改进。此外还新增了 Vim 风格标签栈导航、EditorConfig 继承支持，并改进了包括 Podman 在内的 Dev Container 支持。这些功能显著提升了代码编辑器和 AI 助手的协作体验。

changes.description: 统一输入接口：移除 `mode`, `direct_prompt`, `override_prompt`，合并为单一的 `prompt` 输入
CLI 参数迁移：`custom_instructions`, `model`, `allowed_tools`, `mcp_config` 等配置项迁移至 `claude_args`
